summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting routine trust-account maintenance and proxy filing for a scheduled shareholder extension vote at a blank-check company. No business-combination announcement, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is disclosed. The document updates trust-account balance (~$19.5M) and per-share redemption value (~$12.91), and references a definitive proxy for a fourth extension vote. This is ordinary SPAC administration, not an event-based special situation—equivalent to a periodic status report. No terms, deal structure, or board recommendation on a transaction are present.
